# VitaCrypt
> VitaCrypt unifies a person's whole health, genetics, wearables, labs, microbiome, environment and lifestyle, into one profile that returns actionable, AI-driven, evidence-checked guidance. Private by design.

## Core Concepts
- **Unified profile:** Any health signal fused into one queryable profile (genetics, wearables, labs, microbiome, environment, lifestyle and more), built to grow over time, the more it holds, the better it reads the person. We have not found a product that unifies it this way.
- **Evidence-checked, AI-driven guidance:** Every recommendation cites real literature retrieved live across PubMed, Europe PMC and OpenAlex, graded by publication type; the model cannot invent citations. Genetics grounded on ClinVar, dbSNP and the GWAS Catalog.
- **Actionable, whole-profile:** Guidance is read against your genotype and local environment, not fragmented single-metric readouts.
- **Private by design (FHE):** The trust layer that makes centralizing sensitive data acceptable. Blind compute (the server computing on ciphertext) is demonstrated on one encrypted genetic slice on staging today; production-wide blind compute is on the roadmap. The platform is not yet end-to-end blind: the master key is currently server-side.

## Status
MVP live, pre-launch, founder-led. Targeting the Zama Concrete ML / TFHE stack. Contact: investors@vitacrypt.xyz, t.me/paul_burg.
